description: Use when a preview or staging deploy should match production: it compares the pages of both origins and answers only the pages that differ. Free up to 40 pages a day per client address, no key needed.

checkMode.description: full (existence, content and visual, the default), text-only (no screenshots) or existence-only.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional opaque string a retry repeats: under a prepaid balance the same value within 24 hours is not charged again and answers DUPLICATE_REQUEST with the jobId of the first call.

maxPages.description: Without paths: pages discovery compares, default 10.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional spend cap in USD. A job priced above it is refused before any challenge, so an auto-paying client is never asked for more.

paths.description: Pages to compare, each starting with /; skips discovery.

previewUrl.description: The preview or staging site (full URL), compared as Site B.

productionUrl.description: The production site (full URL), compared as Site A.

threshold.description: Visual diff tolerance as a fraction from 0 (exact) to 1: 0.05 means 5%. The web app takes a percentage; the API does not.

name: diff_deploy
title: Diff deploy
